item: Co-president of the steering committee of Justitia 4.0
type: public governance role (national judiciary digitalisation project)
detail: Justitia 4.0 announced that its steering committee welcomed Federal Judge Yann-Eric Hofmann as its new co-president at its meeting of 24 February 2025, succeeding Federal Judge Nicolas von Werdt, who retired at the end of 2024; he exercises the function jointly with a second co-president. Justitia 4.0 is the national project for the digitalisation of the Swiss judiciary. The announcement gives no end date; whether he still holds the role in October 2026 has not been confirmed.
